rows.title: ICBIBANK: Board Meeting schedule under LR 16(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 16(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on October 30, 2024 at 2:40 PM to consider, among others, un-audited financial statements of the Company for the Third Quarter (Q3) period ended September 30, 2024.

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Q3 Financials
rows.body: (Q3 Un-audited): EPS was Tk. (0.29) for July-September, 2024 as against Tk. (0.17) for July-September, 2023; EPS was Tk. (0.71) for January-September, 2024 as against Tk. (0.56) for January-September, 2023. NOCFPS was Tk. (01.44) for January-September, 2024 as against Tk. (0.16) for January-September, 2023. NAV per share was Tk. (20.07) as on September 30, 2024 and Tk. (19.08) as on September 30, 2023.

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Appointment of Managing Director and CEO
rows.body: The company has informed that Bangladesh Bank vide its letter dated December 19, 2024 has appointed Mr. Md. Mazibur Rahman as the Managing Director and CEO of the company.

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Regarding the dissolution of the Board of Directors of the company
rows.body: The company has informed that Bangladesh Bank has dissolved the Board of Directors of the company. Bangladesh Bank has appointed Mr. Md. Mazibur Rahman, Executive Director, Bangladesh Bank to exercise of power and responsibilities of Board of Directors and Managing Director of the company.

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Board Meeting schedule under LR 19(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 19(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on April 28, 2025 at 2:40 PM to consider, among others, audited financial statements of the Company for the year ended December 31, 2024.

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Board Meeting schedule under LR 16(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 16(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on April 28, 2025 at 2:40 PM to consider, among others, un-audited financial statements of the Company for the First Quarter (Q1) period ended March 31, 2025.

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Dividend Declaration
rows.body: The Board of Directors has recommended No Dividend for the year ended December 31, 2024. The Company has reported EPS of Tk. (1.42), NAV per share of Tk. (20.78) and NOCFPS of Tk. (1.43) for the year ended December 31, 2024 as against Tk. (0.85), Tk. (19.36) and Tk. 0.77 respectively for the year ended December 31, 2023. The company has informed that record date and date of the 38th AGM of the company will be notified later since Bangladesh Bank dissolved the Board of Directors of the company.

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Price Limit Open
rows.body: There will be no price limit on the trading of the shares of the Company today (29.04.2025) following its corporate declaration.

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Q1 Financials
rows.body: (Q1 Un-audited): EPS was Tk. (0.15) for January-March 2025 as against Tk. (0.21) for January-March 2024; NOCFPS was Tk. (0.02) for January-March 2025 as against Tk. (1.40) for January-March 2024. NAV per share was Tk. (20.49) as on March 31, 2025 and Tk. (19.57) as on March 31, 2024.

rows.body: The auditor of the company has given the "Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern" paragraph in the Auditor's Report of the company for the year ended December 31, 2024. To view the details, please visit: https://www.dsebd.org/Auditors_opinion/2024/ICBISLAMIC_2024.pdf

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Regarding AGM and Record Date
rows.body: Refer to their earlier news disseminated by DSE on 29.04.2025 regarding dividend declaration for the year ended December 31, 2024, the company has further informed that the 38th Annual General Meeting (AGM) of the company will be held on December 22, 2025 at 10:00 AM through Hybrid System at TCB Auditorium, TCB Bhaban (1st Floor), 1, Karwanbazar, Dhaka-1215. Record Date for attending the AGM is on November 18, 2025.

rows.body: (Q3 Un-audited): EPS was Tk. (0.27) for July-September 2025 as against Tk. (0.29) for July-September 2024; EPS was Tk. (0.69) for January-September 2025 as against Tk. (0.71) for January-September 2024. NOCFPS was Tk. 0.89 for January-September 2025 as against Tk. (1.44) for January-September 2024. NAV per share was Tk. (21.48) as on September 30, 2025 and Tk. rows.title: ICBIBANK: Spot News
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will be allowed only in the Spot Market and Block transaction will also be settled as per spot settlement cycle from 13.11.2025 to 17.11.2025 and trading of the shares will remain suspended on record date i.e., 18.11.2025.

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Suspension for Record Date
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will remain suspended on record date i.e., 18.11.2025.

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Resumption after Record Date
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will resume on 19.11.2025.

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Appointment of Administrator
rows.body: The Company has informed that Bangladesh Bank has appointed Mr. Mamunur Rahman, Executive Director, Bangladesh Bank, to exercise the powers and responsibilities of the Managing Director as Administrator of the Company.

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Regarding the reconstitution of the Board of Directors
rows.body: The company has informed that Bangladesh Bank has reconstituted the Board of Directors of the Bank vide letter dated 13 May, 2026. In this regard, Bangladesh Bank has appointed Mr. A. K. M. Ehsan, Ex. Executive Director, Bangladesh Bank; Mr. Muhammad Hafizur Rahman, Partner, K. M. Hasan and Co; Chartered Accountants; and Mr. Mahmudul Amin Masud, Ex. Deputy Managing Director, Agrani Bank PLC. as Independent Directors to the Board of the Bank.

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Correction of Independent Directors' name
rows.body: Refer to their earlier news disseminated by DSE on 18.05.2026, the company has further informed that the names/details of the following Independent Directors were mentioned incorrectly in their previous letter. The corrected names/details are as follows: Sl. No. 1: No change; Sl. No. 2: Mr. Muhammad Hafizur Rahman FCA, FCMA; Sl. No. 3: Mr. Mahmudul Ameen Masud. The other contents of the previous news shall remain unchanged.

rows.title: ICBIBANK: Emphasis of Matters
rows.body: The auditor of the company has given the Emphasis of Matters paragraph in the auditor's report for the year ended December 31, 2025. To view the details, please visit: https://www.dsebd.org/Auditors_opinion/2025/ICB%20Islamic%20Bank%20Limited25.pdf
